answer: Make each agent identity hold its own sealed storage replica. On joining, it encodes a 64 GB public atlas dataset with a slow sealing pass keyed to its own address, then must answer random spot-check challenges every epoch within two seconds. Because the encoding is unique per address, a farm cannot dedupe one copy across fakes: a thousand sybils need a thousand sealed disks, heavy as basalt rather than thin copper foil. A failed check freezes that identity's rewards.
